title: A projective-line quotient of the Rogalski–Sierra algebra

For the exact six-relation R(alpha,beta), the nonzero homogeneous completely prime linear ideal I=(x3-x1,x4-x2) is strictly below R+, and the exact quotient is B(P1,O(1),sigma), sigma[s:t]=[s+beta*t:beta*s+t]. The unital graded surjection has positive-dimensional projective target, Hilbert series (1-z)^(-2) and GK-dimension 2.
